policy.rule: Measured deltas are a regression/priority signal for recovery work. A smaller delta is never on its own evidence that a recovered value is the original value.
policy.referenceRule: Original captures carry live game UI. Every region of interest must lie inside the UI-free character band and is validated by the overlay check before use.
policy.alignmentRule: Per-pixel colour metrics are measured after removing the residual reference->recovered camera transform, which is reported separately. Distribution metrics (luminance mean/percentiles, contrast, chroma) are the alignment-robust signals and carry the shading conclusions.
